Tooltip_LWX_NoBuilding: No building within the inverter's reach.
Tooltip_LWX_AlreadyConnected: This building is already connected to an inverter.
Tooltip_LWX_ConnectBuilding: Powers every floor of the building at %1, %2, its basement and a strip around it. The game powers whole 8 x 8 blocks: nearby squares of the same blocks get power too.
Tooltip_LWX_TerminalWires: Uses %1 electric wire. The terminal then powers its 8 x 8 block; set its zone afterwards.
Tooltip_LWX_TerminalNotLinked: Link the terminal to an inverter first.
Tooltip_LWX_NoBuildingNearTerminal: Place the terminal inside a building or right against it.
Tooltip_LWX_PanelLinked: This breaker board is already linked.
Tooltip_LWX_NoBreakerItem: You have no breaker of this kind.
Tooltip_LWX_BoardFull: No free place on the board for this breaker.
Tooltip_LWX_PanelNotLinked: Link the breaker board to an inverter first.
Tooltip_LWX_BreakerRating: %1 A at %2 V: up to %3 W on its circuit.
Tooltip_LWX_PointWires: Uses %1 electric wire. Once a board serves the building, unwired appliances have no current.
Tooltip_LWX_NoBoardNear: No linked breaker board within cable reach.
Tooltip_LWX_NeedPen: Requires a pen or a pencil.
Tooltip_LWX_UnwiredServed: No current: a breaker board serves this building and this appliance is wired to no breaker.
